lessons.solution_code:
import base64, json

def jwt_payload(token):
    parts = token.split('.')
    payload = parts[1]
    pad = '=' * (-len(payload) % 4)
    raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload + pad)
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))

tests.name: test_jwt_payload
tests.unittest_code:
def test_jwt_payload(self):
    import base64, json
    payload = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({'sub': '1'}).encode()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
    token = 'x.' + payload + '.y'
    self.assertEqual(jwt_payload(token), {'sub': '1'})

lessons.title: 4. Expiry Check (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `is_expired(payload, now)` True if payload exp <= now.
lessons.solution_code:
def is_expired(payload, now):
    return payload.get('exp', 0) <= now

lessons.title: 5. Checkpoint: Refresh Decision
lessons.description: Implement `should_refresh(payload, now, skew=30)` True if exp - now <= skew.
lessons.solution_code:
def should_refresh(payload, now, skew=30):
    return payload.get('exp', 0) - now <= skew
